description: This Dart source file defines the StepsProvider class, which manages the state for steps in an AI tutoring platform application's frontend. It handles the current step index, expansion states of steps, and navigation methods.

classes.name: StepsProvider
classes.description: Manages current visible step index and expansion states for a list of ProblemStep models. Extends ChangeNotifier to notify listeners about state changes.

methods.name: StepsProvider
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the steps and expansion states, optionally from a provided list of steps.

methods.name: steps
methods.description: Returns an unmodifiable list of the problem steps.

methods.name: currentIndex
methods.description: Returns the current focused step index.

methods.name: expanded
methods.description: Returns an unmodifiable list of expansion states for the steps.

methods.name: toggleExpanded
methods.description: Toggles the expansion state of a specific step by index.

methods.name: expandOnly
methods.description: Expands only the specified step and collapses all others.

methods.name: nextStep
methods.description: Advances to the next step if available, auto-expanding it.

methods.name: prevStep
methods.description: Goes back to the previous step if available, auto-expanding it.

methods.name: setCurrentIndex
methods.description: Sets the current step index, clamped within bounds, and expands it.
